LAREDO — A 45-year-old man was booked into the Webb County Jail on Thursday on a third-degree felony charge stemming from a crash that caused serious bodily injury, according to the Webb County Sheriff's Office booking records.

Ernesto Alfonso Hernandez Jr. was arrested on October 23, 2026, at 2:45 p.m. The booking record charges him with accident involving serious bodily injury — a third-degree felony under Texas law. Bond had not been set as of booking.

The booking record does not list an arresting agency.

A charge is an allegation, and every person is presumed innocent until proven guilty.

Sources: Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search; Webb County public-access court records.

title: BREAKING: Ernesto Alfonso Hernandez Jr. arrested on third-degree felony charge in serious-injury crash
